method: A headless VST3 host restored the initialized state (fixtures/init.vstpreset) and set each synth parameter to normalized 0, 1 and 0.25 through the controller (setParamNormalized) and the processor's input parameter queue, then read both halves back with getState. The one processor field that moved is the parameter's stored field. Only that value, written as Kumi writes it, was patched into a fresh initialized processor state and loaded into a second instance: readback is the parameter's normalized value after that load (stepped parameters land on their step), plainReadback its normalizedParamToPlain, and reread the value the plug-in saved again (null where Serum leaves a default out). stored at a point where Serum wrote nothing is the value that reloads to that point. Text enumerations were measured at every step: options records the stored text and the host's label for each step, each reloaded alone. Bounds apply only to the verified concrete mappings; other indices stay read-only.

serum2-2.1.5-501e7bb3.note: the first 14 oscillator enable, level and coarse pitch mappings, measured by the same method with the same stored values

modulationMethod: Mod matrix, measured on 2026-11-08 with the same host: each request patched a fresh initialized processor state, loaded it into a new instance, read the host parameters back, saved, and rendered middle C an octave down (key 48, velocity 0.8) for 300 blocks of 256 samples at 48 kHz, releasing it at block 240. A render is summarized by its spectral centroid and RMS per 2048-sample window; the same state renders identically every time, so any difference is the change. Filter 1 was on at freq 0.3 wherever a slot drove Filter 1 Freq. Sources: each candidate number routed to Filter 1 Freq at amount 50, then every stimulus was applied in turn; response is the largest centroid change (Hz), and a source is named when its largest response is at least five times the next. Destinations: a slot naming the destination by its stored key with destModuleParamID 0 was saved back by Serum with its own number (stored); that slot then reloaded unchanged (fixedPoint) and, driven by Macro 1 at 100 (Macro 2 for a Macro 1 destination), amount +100 or -100 changed the render against amount 0. setup lists what was switched on so the destination is heard. slotChecks are the amount, output and bipolar renders behind the ranges.

16.stimulus: note velocity 0.25 instead of 0.8 (less the change without the slot)

17.stimulus: key 48 with Osc A an octave down against key 36 (the same pitch)

33.stimulus: host parameter Pitch Bend set to 1 (less the change without the slot)
